project.title: Metagenomic profiling of antibiotic resistant bacteria in domestic effluent
project.description: This study investigates the prevalence of multi-drug resistant bacteria (ARBs) in domestic effluent and explores the influence of metallic nanoparticles on ARBs. Domestic wastewater serves as a significant reservoir for antibiotic-resistant pathogens, posing risks to public health and environmental ecosystems. Metallic nanoparticles got attention for their potential role in mitigating antibiotic resistance through various mechanisms. This research aims to elucidate the interactions between metallic nanoparticles and ARBs in domestic effluent, offering insights into potential interventions for managing antibiotic resistance in wastewater treatment systems.
